x: Amid scenes unparalleled at any Belgrave event, the Mayor of Wimbledon, Councillor S. Black, O.B.E., J.P., started 84 runners on their way in our first 20 miles Open Road Race, and so successful was the promotion that it undoubtedly established itself as the first of many more to come.
Our finishers were the same two that were finishing "Nationals" 25 years ago. Women's 5k: 1, S.Black (Birchfield) 25:18; 14, K.Barker 32:20; 15, S.Porter 32:27; 20, G.Brackpool 34:19
